existing.title: 大型電力變壓器製造
existing.summary: 以不通電的圖面與報告判讀，串連變比、鐵心、繞組、絕緣、乾燥、冷卻及工廠驗收。
existing.summaryEn: Connect ratio, core, windings, insulation, drying, cooling and factory acceptance using de-energized schematics and report interpretation.

stages.title: 電磁需求與主動部件
stages.description: 將額定需求轉成鐵心、繞組與損失的設計問題。
stages.descriptionEn: Translate ratings into core, winding and loss considerations.

steps.title: 界定變比、容量與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Define ratio, rating and system boundary
steps.objective: 區分電壓比、容量、頻率與冷卻條件。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish voltage ratio, power rating, frequency and cooling conditions.
steps.instruction: 畫出一次側、磁心、二次側與冷卻系統，在紙上名牌分別填入明確假設的電壓比、容量與頻率。比較兩台變比相同但容量不同的設備，說明為何不能互換使用。
steps.instructionEn: Draw primary, core, secondary and cooling system. Enter explicitly hypothetical ratio, rating and frequency on a paper nameplate, then compare equal-ratio units with different ratings and explain why they are not interchangeable.
steps.observation: 相同變比不代表具有相同導體尺寸、散熱能力或絕緣配置。
steps.observationEn: Equal ratio does not imply equal conductor size, cooling capability or insulation arrangement.
steps.failure: 把電壓比當作全部規格，會漏掉電流、熱及系統條件。
steps.failureEn: Treating voltage ratio as the complete specification omits current, thermal and system conditions.
steps.check: 需求表分開列明變比、額定能力、頻率及使用環境假設。
steps.checkEn: Record ratio, rated capability, frequency and environmental assumptions separately.

knowledge.title: 額定條件
knowledge.text: 額定能力必須連同適用條件解讀。
knowledge.textEn: Rated capability must be interpreted with its applicable conditions.

knowledge.title: 系統邊界
knowledge.text: 主動部件、絕緣與冷卻共同限制可用能力。
knowledge.textEn: Active parts, insulation and cooling jointly constrain usable capability.

quiz.question: 兩台變壓器變比相同，能否直接互換？
quiz.questionEn: Can equal-ratio transformers be exchanged without further review?
options: 不能，還需核對容量、頻率、絕緣及系統條件。
能，變比相同代表額定電流也必然相同。
能，兩台只要具有相同端子數便完全相容。
optionsEn: No; rating, frequency, insulation and system conditions still need checking.
Yes; equal ratio guarantees equal current ratings.
Yes; equal terminal count establishes full compatibility.
quiz.explanation: 不能，還需核對容量、頻率、絕緣及系統條件。 額定能力必須連同適用條件解讀。
quiz.explanationEn: No; rating, frequency, insulation and system conditions still need checking. Rated capability must be interpreted with its applicable conditions.

steps.title: 用理想模型核對匝數比與功率
steps.titleEn: Check turns ratio and power in an ideal model
steps.objective: 理解升壓與電流變化的對應，而不把理想結果當額定設計。
steps.objectiveEn: Relate voltage transformation to current without treating an ideal result as rated design.
steps.instruction: 在紙上假設匝數比 10:1、一次電壓 100 V，推得理想二次電壓 10 V。再假設功率因數為 1 的理想輸出 100 W，求兩側電流並檢查功率平衡；這些只作算術，不接線通電。
steps.instructionEn: On paper, assume a 10:1 turns ratio and 100 V primary to obtain 10 V ideally. Assume 100 W ideal output at unity power factor, calculate both currents and check power balance; perform no wiring or energization.
steps.observation: 降壓時理想二次電流增加，並不是憑空產生更多功率。
steps.observationEn: In step-down operation, ideal secondary current increases without creating extra power.
steps.failure: 將電壓與電流比同方向套用會破壞能量平衡。
steps.failureEn: Applying voltage and current ratios in the same direction breaks the ideal power balance.
steps.check: 得到一次 1 A、二次 10 A，並列出損失與激磁尚未納入。
steps.checkEn: Obtain 1 A primary and 10 A secondary and state that losses and excitation are omitted.

knowledge.title: 理想能量平衡
knowledge.text: 理想變壓器改變電壓與電流的比例，同時維持功率平衡。
knowledge.textEn: An ideal transformer changes voltage and current ratios while conserving power.

knowledge.title: 模型限制
knowledge.text: 實際設備有損失、激磁與熱限制，不能由匝數比推得所有額定能力。 此例電流試算另假設功率因數為 1。
knowledge.textEn: Real units have losses, excitation and thermal limits; turns ratio does not determine every rating. The current calculation also assumes unity power factor.

quiz.question: 本例理想二次電流為多少？
quiz.questionEn: What is the ideal secondary current in this example?
quiz.explanation: 10 A。 理想變壓器改變電壓與電流的比例，同時維持功率平衡。
quiz.explanationEn: 10 A. An ideal transformer changes voltage and current ratios while conserving power.

steps.title: 辨認疊片磁心與磁路連續性
steps.titleEn: Identify a laminated core and magnetic path
steps.objective: 區分導磁路徑與導電短接風險。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish the magnetic path from unwanted conductive paths.
steps.instruction: 用原創截面畫出柱、軛與絕緣疊片，沿磁路追蹤一圈。比較整塊導電材料與薄片隔離的概念，並把接縫、缺口及裝配受力列為需由設計文件確認的項目。
steps.instructionEn: Draw limbs, yokes and insulated laminations and trace the magnetic path. Compare a solid conductive core with isolated sheets and list joints, gaps and assembly loads for review against the design documentation.
steps.observation: 層間絕緣與磁路連續具有不同目的，不能互相取代。
steps.observationEn: Interlaminar insulation and magnetic continuity serve different purposes.
steps.failure: 若把所有疊片用導電橋連成一體，不能只憑機械更牢固就判定改善。
steps.failureEn: Conductively bridging laminations cannot be judged beneficial merely because the structure appears stronger.
steps.check: 模型清楚標示磁路、疊片方向與應保護的層間狀態。
steps.checkEn: Mark the magnetic path, lamination orientation and interlaminar condition to preserve.

knowledge.title: 疊片作用
knowledge.text: 磁心使用分層電工鋼，以兼顧導磁與損失控制。
knowledge.textEn: Layered electrical steel supports magnetic flux while helping control losses.

knowledge.title: 接縫與機械
knowledge.text: 接縫配置與支撐須服從核准設計，不能由外觀任意改動。
knowledge.textEn: Joint layout and support follow an approved design, not arbitrary visual preference.

quiz.question: 為何不能把層間絕緣視為無關細節？
quiz.questionEn: Why is interlaminar insulation not a trivial detail?
options: 它只影響表面防鏽，不影響電磁損失。
只要磁心尺寸足夠，層間導電狀態便不重要。
它關係到不希望出現的導電路徑與損失。
optionsEn: It affects only corrosion protection, not electromagnetic loss.
Sufficient core size makes interlaminar conduction irrelevant.
It affects unwanted conductive paths and losses.
quiz.explanation: 它關係到不希望出現的導電路徑與損失。 磁心使用分層電工鋼，以兼顧導磁與損失控制。
quiz.explanationEn: It affects unwanted conductive paths and losses. Layered electrical steel supports magnetic flux while helping control losses.

steps.title: 比較繞組導體、電阻與熱負擔
steps.titleEn: Compare winding conductors, resistance and heat
steps.objective: 把電流路徑與熱產生連在一起。
steps.objectiveEn: Connect current paths to heat generation.
steps.instruction: 在繞組示意圖標出導體長度、截面與連接點。以相同電阻的假設比較電流 I 與 2I 的 I²R 損失，再指出實際設計還需考慮交流與散熱效應。
steps.instructionEn: Mark conductor length, cross-section and joints on a winding schematic. At hypothetical fixed resistance, compare I²R loss for I and 2I, then identify additional AC and cooling considerations in real design.
steps.observation: 局部接點電阻偏高可形成熱點，即使整體尺寸看起來合理。
steps.observationEn: Elevated local joint resistance can create a hotspot even when overall dimensions look reasonable.
steps.failure: 只用直流電阻估計所有交流損失會不完整；保留模型邊界。
steps.failureEn: DC resistance alone does not capture every AC loss; keep the model boundary explicit.
steps.check: 說明電流加倍的示例損失變成四倍，而非把它當作整機溫升預測。
steps.checkEn: Explain fourfold loss in the doubled-current example without claiming a full-unit temperature-rise prediction.

knowledge.title: 電阻熱
knowledge.text: 固定電阻的 I²R 模型顯示電流增加會更快增加熱負擔。
knowledge.textEn: At fixed resistance, I²R shows heat burden increasing faster than current.

knowledge.title: 熱點與平均
knowledge.text: 平均溫度不能保證局部接點沒有異常。
knowledge.textEn: An average temperature does not rule out abnormal local joints.

quiz.question: 固定電阻下電流加倍，電阻損失如何變化？
quiz.questionEn: With fixed resistance, how does resistive loss change when current doubles?
options: 變成四倍。
保持不變。
減為四分之一。
optionsEn: It becomes four times greater.
It stays unchanged.
It becomes one quarter.
quiz.explanation: 變成四倍。 固定電阻的 I²R 模型顯示電流增加會更快增加熱負擔。
quiz.explanationEn: It becomes four times greater. At fixed resistance, I²R shows heat burden increasing faster than current.

stages.title: 絕緣與機械整合
stages.description: 把絕緣、支撐、乾燥與油箱視為互相影響的系統。
stages.descriptionEn: Treat insulation, support, drying and tanking as interacting systems.

steps.title: 配置主絕緣、匝間絕緣與油隙
steps.titleEn: Map major insulation, turn insulation and oil gaps
steps.objective: 分辨不同電位之間的絕緣任務。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish insulation duties between different potentials.
steps.instruction: 在不通電的剖面模型為繞組、磁心與油箱標記相對電位，將匝間、繞組間及對地絕緣分色。比較改變間距對電場和空間配置的概念影響，不自行指定高壓耐受值。
steps.instructionEn: In a de-energized section, label relative potentials of windings, core and tank. Color turn, winding-to-winding and ground insulation separately and compare spacing effects without inventing high-voltage withstand ratings.
steps.observation: 同一厚度的材料處於不同幾何位置，可能承受不同局部電場。
steps.observationEn: Equal material thickness in different geometries can face different local electric fields.
steps.failure: 只增加某處間距而阻擋冷卻通道，可能改善一項卻損害另一項。
steps.failureEn: Increasing a clearance while obstructing cooling can improve one aspect and harm another.
steps.check: 標示各絕緣介面、其功能與需由正式設計確認的條件。
steps.checkEn: Mark each insulation interface, its function and conditions requiring formal design verification.

knowledge.title: 多介面絕緣
knowledge.text: 紙、壓板與絕緣液各承擔不同介面和支撐功能。
knowledge.textEn: Paper, pressboard and insulating liquid serve different interface and support functions.

knowledge.title: 電熱耦合
knowledge.text: 絕緣配置亦影響散熱及機械布局，不能只看單一間距。
knowledge.textEn: Insulation layout also affects cooling and mechanics, not just one clearance.

quiz.question: 增加絕緣距離時，還應共同檢查什麼？
quiz.questionEn: What else should be checked when insulation spacing increases?
options: 只需重新計算匝數比，熱路徑不會受影響。
冷卻通道與機械布局是否受影響。
只要絕緣材料相同，機械與冷卻布局不需重查。
optionsEn: Recalculate only turns ratio; thermal paths cannot be affected.
Whether cooling paths and mechanical layout are affected.
Identical insulation material eliminates review of mechanical and cooling layout.
quiz.explanation: 冷卻通道與機械布局是否受影響。 紙、壓板與絕緣液各承擔不同介面和支撐功能。
quiz.explanationEn: Whether cooling paths and mechanical layout are affected. Paper, pressboard and insulating liquid serve different interface and support functions.

steps.title: 追蹤繞組支撐與力的傳遞
steps.titleEn: Trace winding support and load paths
steps.objective: 理解異常電流下的機械完整性需要設計驗證。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand that mechanical integrity under abnormal current requires design verification.
steps.instruction: 在繞組、墊塊、夾件與支架示意圖畫出徑向和軸向受力路徑。比較支撐完整與缺少一處支撐的案例，指出哪些位移可能損害絕緣；不提供現場鎖固力矩。
steps.instructionEn: Draw radial and axial load paths through windings, spacers, clamps and supports. Compare complete support with one missing support and identify displacements that could damage insulation without prescribing tightening torque.
steps.observation: 外殼沒有明顯變形，不代表內部繞組位置沒有改變。
steps.observationEn: An unchanged enclosure does not prove unchanged internal winding positions.
steps.failure: 過度夾緊可能損害材料，不能以「越緊越安全」取代設計。
steps.failureEn: Excessive clamping can damage materials; tighter is safer cannot replace design.
steps.check: 每條受力路徑有明確支撐介面，未知強度列為待驗證。
steps.checkEn: Give each load path a defined support interface and mark unknown strength as unverified.

knowledge.title: 機電耦合
knowledge.text: 電流相關作用力與機械支撐共同影響繞組完整性。
knowledge.textEn: Current-related forces and mechanical support jointly affect winding integrity.

knowledge.title: 形變證據
knowledge.text: 內部幾何變化可能需要專門試驗與前後基線比較才能判斷。
knowledge.textEn: Internal geometric change may need dedicated testing and before/after baselines.

quiz.question: 看到油箱外觀完整，能否證明繞組支撐全部正常？
quiz.questionEn: Does an intact tank exterior prove every winding support is sound?
options: 能，外殼會顯示所有內部位移。
能，絕緣材料不可能受到機械影響。
不能，內部狀態仍需相應證據。
optionsEn: Yes; the enclosure reveals every internal displacement.
Yes; insulation cannot be mechanically affected.
No; internal condition still needs appropriate evidence.
quiz.explanation: 不能，內部狀態仍需相應證據。 電流相關作用力與機械支撐共同影響繞組完整性。
quiz.explanationEn: No; internal condition still needs appropriate evidence. Current-related forces and mechanical support jointly affect winding integrity.

steps.title: 規劃乾燥與防再吸濕的交接
steps.titleEn: Plan drying and protection against rewetting
steps.objective: 把乾燥結果與後續暴露控制連接。
steps.objectiveEn: Connect drying results with subsequent exposure control.
steps.instruction: 畫出主動部件組裝、專業乾燥、封閉轉移及入箱的流程。以兩個假設時程比較乾燥後立即受控交接與長時間不受控暴露，列出需要保留的含水和環境紀錄。
steps.instructionEn: Map active-part assembly, professional drying, protected transfer and tanking. Compare controlled handoff with prolonged uncontrolled exposure and list moisture and environmental records to retain.
steps.observation: 乾燥完成時合格，不代表之後仍維持相同含水狀態。
steps.observationEn: Passing at the end of drying does not guarantee unchanged moisture afterward.
steps.failure: 只記乾燥時間而缺少結果與暴露紀錄，不能證明交付狀態。
steps.failureEn: Drying time without outcome and exposure records does not establish the delivered condition.
steps.check: 交接表同時包含乾燥證據、時間線與再吸濕防護。
steps.checkEn: Include drying evidence, timeline and rewetting protection in the handoff record.

knowledge.title: 含水影響
knowledge.text: 水分會影響絕緣性能與老化，因此需要受控處理。
knowledge.textEn: Moisture affects insulation performance and aging and therefore needs controlled handling.

knowledge.title: 狀態保持
knowledge.text: 完成一個製程後，仍需維持其成果直到下一站。
knowledge.textEn: A completed process result must be preserved until the next operation.

quiz.question: 乾燥後長時間暴露且沒有紀錄，能否沿用原先合格結論？
quiz.questionEn: After long unrecorded exposure, can the original drying pass simply be reused?
options: 不能，需要重新確認目前狀態。
能，只要原乾燥設備的設定未改變。
能，乾燥時間已記錄就能代表之後的含水狀態。
optionsEn: No; the present condition needs confirmation.
Yes, if the original dryer settings remain unchanged.
Yes; recorded drying time represents all later moisture conditions.
quiz.explanation: 不能，需要重新確認目前狀態。 水分會影響絕緣性能與老化，因此需要受控處理。
quiz.explanationEn: No; the present condition needs confirmation. Moisture affects insulation performance and aging and therefore needs controlled handling.

steps.title: 整合油箱、密封與冷卻路徑
steps.titleEn: Integrate tank, seals and cooling paths
steps.objective: 辨認絕緣液保存與熱移除的不同功能。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish insulating-liquid preservation from heat removal.
steps.instruction: 在油箱剖面標出熱源、液體流路、散熱器及對外密封界面。比較通道順暢與局部阻擋的模型，另列出密封證據，避免以「沒有漏油」代替冷卻驗證。
steps.instructionEn: Mark heat sources, liquid paths, radiators and external seals in a tank section. Compare clear and obstructed flow models and list sealing evidence separately from cooling verification.
steps.observation: 密封良好與散熱足夠是不同指標，兩者都不能由外觀單獨證明。
steps.observationEn: Adequate sealing and adequate cooling are different criteria, neither proven by appearance alone.
steps.failure: 把冷卻通道當作可任意填滿的空隙，可能造成熱點。
steps.failureEn: Treating cooling passages as expendable empty space can create hotspots.
steps.check: 熱路徑與密封界面各有獨立檢核，並保留適用的冷卻條件。
steps.checkEn: Give heat paths and seals separate checks and retain applicable cooling conditions.

knowledge.title: 熱路徑
knowledge.text: 繞組損失必須經材料與冷卻系統傳到環境。
knowledge.textEn: Winding heat must pass through materials and cooling systems to the environment.

knowledge.title: 液體保存
knowledge.text: 絕緣液的污染和水分狀態也取決於保存及密封設計。
knowledge.textEn: Contamination and moisture in insulating liquid also depend on preservation and sealing design.

quiz.question: 油箱不漏油，是否足以證明冷卻設計合格？
quiz.questionEn: Does a leak-free tank prove adequate cooling design?
options: 足夠，油量正確便能保證所有局部流路暢通。
不足，熱移除能力還需獨立驗證。
足夠，密封試驗已涵蓋額定熱負載下的表現。
optionsEn: Yes; correct oil quantity guarantees every local flow path is clear.
No; heat-removal capability needs separate verification.
Yes; a seal test covers performance under rated thermal load.
quiz.explanation: 不足，熱移除能力還需獨立驗證。 繞組損失必須經材料與冷卻系統傳到環境。
quiz.explanationEn: No; heat-removal capability needs separate verification. Winding heat must pass through materials and cooling systems to the environment.

stages.title: 附件、試驗與交付
stages.description: 理解不同試驗的證據範圍，保留運輸前後的比較基線。
stages.descriptionEn: Understand the limits of each test and retain pre/post-transport baselines.

steps.title: 核對套管、分接與監測介面
steps.titleEn: Check bushings, taps and monitoring interfaces
steps.objective: 將附件的電氣、機械與監測責任明確分開。
steps.objectiveEn: Separate electrical, mechanical and monitoring roles of accessories.
steps.instruction: 用系統圖連接套管、繞組分接位置、溫度與油位監測。為每個介面寫出輸入、輸出及應核對文件；區分分接裝置類型，不示範現場切換或帶電操作。
steps.instructionEn: Connect bushings, winding tap positions, temperature and oil-level monitoring in a system diagram. Record inputs, outputs and documents to check, distinguishing tap-device types without demonstrating field switching or live operation.
steps.observation: 附件型號相近也可能有不同電氣等級、安裝界面或操作限制。
steps.observationEn: Similar accessory models can differ in electrical rating, mounting interface or operating limits.
steps.failure: 把所有分接裝置都假定可帶載切換，會造成錯誤操作理解。
steps.failureEn: Assuming every tap device can switch under load creates a dangerous misunderstanding.
steps.check: 介面表包含相容性與操作類型，未知項目不以推測補足。
steps.checkEn: Include compatibility and operating type, leaving unknown items unverified rather than guessed.

knowledge.title: 介面相容性
knowledge.text: 附件需符合主體設計，機械可裝上並不代表電氣相容。
knowledge.textEn: Accessories must match the main design; mechanical fit does not prove electrical compatibility.

knowledge.title: 監測限制
knowledge.text: 監測器提供特定狀態資訊，不能取代所有工廠試驗。
knowledge.textEn: Sensors report particular conditions and do not replace all factory tests.

quiz.question: 兩種分接裝置外觀相似，可否假定操作方式相同？
quiz.questionEn: Two tap devices look similar. Can their operating method be assumed identical?
options: 可以，只要名義變比相同便代表切換條件相同。
可以，機械接口吻合就不需查閱電氣操作類型。
不可，應核對裝置類型與正式規範。
optionsEn: Yes; equal nominal ratio implies equal switching conditions.
Yes; mechanical fit removes the need to check the electrical operating type.
No; verify device type and formal requirements.
quiz.explanation: 不可，應核對裝置類型與正式規範。 附件需符合主體設計，機械可裝上並不代表電氣相容。
quiz.explanationEn: No; verify device type and formal requirements. Accessories must match the main design; mechanical fit does not prove electrical compatibility.

steps.title: 閱讀工廠試驗的不同證據
steps.titleEn: Interpret distinct factory-test evidence
steps.objective: 把變比、損失、阻抗與絕緣試驗對應到不同問題。
steps.objectiveEn: Map ratio, loss, impedance and insulation tests to different questions.
steps.instruction: 使用自製空白試驗報告模板，分別列出變比、繞組電阻、損失、阻抗及絕緣相關試驗的目的。加入一項假設超限結果，選擇應回查的設計或製造紀錄；不搭建高壓試驗回路。
steps.instructionEn: Use an original blank report template to list purposes of ratio, winding resistance, loss, impedance and insulation-related tests. Add a hypothetical out-of-limit result and select records to review without building a high-voltage test circuit.
steps.observation: 通過變比檢查不能替代絕緣或熱性能證據。
steps.observationEn: Passing a ratio check does not replace insulation or thermal evidence.
steps.failure: 跨不同試驗條件比較數字可能產生假異常；先核對條件和單位。
steps.failureEn: Comparing values from different test conditions can create false anomalies; check conditions and units first.
steps.check: 每項試驗都有目的、條件、判據來源及不涵蓋的範圍。
steps.checkEn: Give each test a purpose, conditions, criteria source and excluded scope.

knowledge.title: 試驗分工
knowledge.text: 多種試驗共同驗證不同性能，沒有一個結果代表全部合格。
knowledge.textEn: Different tests verify different properties; no single result proves complete compliance.

knowledge.title: 條件正規化
knowledge.text: 報告需保留溫度、接法與參考條件等解讀必要資訊。
knowledge.textEn: Reports need interpretive context such as temperature, connection and reference conditions.

quiz.question: 變比正確但絕緣證據尚未取得，應如何判定？
quiz.questionEn: Ratio is correct but insulation evidence is missing. What follows?
options: 只能確認已測的變比，整體驗收仍未完成。
變比正確可取代所有介電和熱性能證據。
只要試驗報告有簽名，缺少的項目可視為已完成。
optionsEn: Only the measured ratio is confirmed; overall acceptance is incomplete.
Correct ratio replaces all dielectric and thermal evidence.
A signed report lets missing tests be treated as completed.
quiz.explanation: 只能確認已測的變比，整體驗收仍未完成。 多種試驗共同驗證不同性能，沒有一個結果代表全部合格。
quiz.explanationEn: Only the measured ratio is confirmed; overall acceptance is incomplete. Different tests verify different properties; no single result proves complete compliance.

steps.title: 建立油與絕緣的診斷基線
steps.titleEn: Establish oil and insulation diagnostic baselines
steps.objective: 以趨勢與多項證據判讀，而非單一數字猜測故障。
steps.objectiveEn: Interpret trends and combined evidence rather than diagnose from one number.
steps.instruction: 在紙上報告分開列出水分、介電性質、溶解氣體及相關材料狀態。用兩組假設時間序列比較穩定與變化情境，說明需要哪些運行背景；不實作現場取樣。
steps.instructionEn: Separate moisture, dielectric properties, dissolved gases and material condition in a paper report. Compare two hypothetical time series, stable and changing, and list operating context needed without field sampling.
steps.observation: 相同最終數值可能來自不同歷程，不能忽略趨勢與取樣條件。
steps.observationEn: Identical final values can arise from different histories; trends and sampling conditions matter.
steps.failure: 單一氣體或單次數值不宜被簡化成唯一故障原因。
steps.failureEn: One gas or one reading should not be reduced to a unique fault diagnosis.
steps.check: 判讀說明基線、趨勢、可能原因與追加證據需求。
steps.checkEn: State baseline, trend, possible causes and further evidence needed.

knowledge.title: 條件診斷
knowledge.text: 油與氣體分析可提供內部狀態線索，仍需結合設計與運行資訊。
knowledge.textEn: Oil and gas analysis provide internal-condition clues that still need design and operating context.

knowledge.title: 基線價值
knowledge.text: 初始紀錄讓之後的變化具有比較依據。
knowledge.textEn: Initial records make later changes interpretable.

quiz.question: 兩台設備最終數值相同但變化速度不同，應如何處理？
quiz.questionEn: Two units have the same final reading but different rates of change. What should be done?
options: 直接認定兩台狀態完全相同。
結合各自基線、趨勢與運行背景判讀。
只保留最後一筆並刪除時間。
optionsEn: Declare their conditions identical.
Interpret each using its baseline, trend and operating context.
Keep only the last value and delete timestamps.
quiz.explanation: 結合各自基線、趨勢與運行背景判讀。 油與氣體分析可提供內部狀態線索，仍需結合設計與運行資訊。
quiz.explanationEn: Interpret each using its baseline, trend and operating context. Oil and gas analysis provide internal-condition clues that still need design and operating context.

steps.title: 規劃運輸前後的驗證交接
steps.titleEn: Plan verification across transportation
steps.objective: 保存拆卸、運輸及到貨後可比較的證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Preserve comparable evidence across disassembly, transport and arrival.
steps.instruction: 畫出工廠驗收、運輸準備、物流交接、到貨檢查與專業再組裝五個狀態。列出每次交接的零件身分、保存條件及基線報告，加入一個運輸異常以決定應暫停哪項後續工作。
steps.instructionEn: Map factory acceptance, transport preparation, logistics handoff, arrival inspection and professional reassembly. Record component identity, preservation and baseline reports, then add a transport anomaly to decide which later work must pause.
steps.observation: 出廠合格不能排除運輸過程中發生的變化。
steps.observationEn: Factory acceptance does not rule out changes during transport.
steps.failure: 忽略異常後直接推進投運，會失去確認狀態的機會；此課程不提供投運操作。
steps.failureEn: Proceeding after an unresolved anomaly loses the chance to verify condition; this course provides no energization procedure.
steps.check: 交接清單可追蹤每項異常、負責人與所需專業複查，保留未放行狀態。
steps.checkEn: Trace anomalies, responsibility and required professional review while retaining an unreleased status where appropriate.

knowledge.title: 狀態保持與重驗
knowledge.text: 大型設備的運輸與再組裝是品質鏈的一部分。
knowledge.textEn: Transportation and reassembly are part of the quality chain for large equipment.

knowledge.title: 證據可比性
knowledge.text: 前後量測需有一致的基準和條件，才能判讀是否改變。
knowledge.textEn: Before-and-after measurements need consistent references and conditions to reveal change.

quiz.question: 運輸紀錄有異常但外觀正常，最佳下一步為何？
quiz.questionEn: Transport records show an anomaly but the exterior looks normal. What is the best next step?
options: 出廠試驗已合格，所以可忽略運輸後的新證據。
只重複外觀檢查，就可排除所有內部變化。
保留異常並依專業程序追加檢查後再決定放行。
optionsEn: Factory acceptance allows new post-transport evidence to be ignored.
Repeating a visual inspection rules out every internal change.
Retain the anomaly and obtain appropriate professional checks before release.
quiz.explanation: 保留異常並依專業程序追加檢查後再決定放行。 大型設備的運輸與再組裝是品質鏈的一部分。
quiz.explanationEn: Retain the anomaly and obtain appropriate professional checks before release. Transportation and reassembly are part of the quality chain for large equipment.

existing.scope: 公開原理的十二項教學任務，以自行繪製的示意模型、試算及來源資料進行；未提供工廠實測資料、專有配方或設備操作許可。 只進行不通電的示意、試算及報告判讀；高壓試驗、起吊、乾燥、充液與投運均須由合格人員依正式程序執行。
existing.scopeEn: Twelve educational tasks based on public principles, using original schematic models, calculations and referenced material. No factory measurement dataset, proprietary recipe or equipment operating authorization is supplied. Uses de-energized diagrams, calculations and report interpretation only; high-voltage tests, lifting, drying, filling and commissioning require qualified personnel and formal procedures.

existing.title: 高壓直流換流站
existing.summary: 從兩端電網需求、LCC/VSC 選擇、變壓器與閥廳，到冷卻、控制、故障回放及工廠驗收規劃，完成換流站概念設計。
existing.summaryEn: Develop a converter-station concept from grid needs, LCC/VSC choices, transformers and valves through cooling, control, fault replay and factory-test planning.
existing.scope: 依公開原理編寫的四階段、24 個教學工作包；每步需交出模型、判讀或驗證紀錄。數值練習為自訂教學案例，不是廠商製程配方、現場操作許可或專業設計認證。
existing.scopeEn: Four stages and 24 educational work packages based on public principles. Each step produces a model, interpretation or verification record. Numerical exercises are hypothetical, not manufacturer recipes, field operating authorization or professional design certification.

stages.title: 電網需求與架構
stages.description: 界定功率、電壓、電網與拓撲的設計邊界。
stages.descriptionEn: Define power, voltage, grid and topology boundaries.

steps.title: 界定兩端電網與服務需求
steps.titleEn: Define both grids and the required service
steps.objective: 分開輸送功率與電網支持目標。
steps.objectiveEn: Separate transmitted power from grid-support goals.
steps.instruction: 畫兩端交流電網及中間直流鏈路；列出能量輸送與電壓支持需求；標記正常與備援情境；把未知短路強度列成待取得資料。
steps.instructionEn: Draw both AC grids and the DC link; list power-transfer and voltage-support needs; mark normal and contingency cases; flag unknown grid strength.
steps.observation: 額定功率一項不足以描述站的工作。
steps.observationEn: A power rating alone does not describe station duties.
steps.failure: 若需求只剩 MW 數字，加入方向、可用率及電網條件。
steps.failureEn: Add direction, availability and grid conditions to a MW-only requirement.
steps.check: 需求表清楚標示已知、假設與待確認項。
steps.checkEn: Requirements distinguish known, assumed and unresolved items.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: HVDC 是兩端電網之間的可控能量介面。
knowledge.textEn: HVDC forms a controllable energy interface between grids.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 兩端條件可能不同，應分別建模。
knowledge.textEn: Terminal conditions can differ and need separate models.

quiz.question: 設計換流站首先需要什麼？
quiz.questionEn: What comes first in converter-station design?
options: 兩端電網及服務需求。
只決定閥廳外觀。
先指定任意保護門檻。
optionsEn: Both grid conditions and service requirements.
Only valve-hall appearance.
Arbitrary protection thresholds first.
quiz.explanation: 兩端電網及服務需求。 HVDC 是兩端電網之間的可控能量介面。
quiz.explanationEn: Both grid conditions and service requirements. HVDC forms a controllable energy interface between grids.

steps.title: 建立 AC 到 DC 的能量帳本
steps.titleEn: Build the AC-to-DC energy ledger
steps.objective: 分辨輸入、輸出與損耗。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish input, output and losses.
steps.instruction: 為兩站及線路畫功率箭頭；用自訂低精度假設值計算損耗；檢查送端與受端能量平衡；另列站用電。
steps.instructionEn: Draw power arrows for both stations and the line; calculate losses with clearly hypothetical values; balance sending and receiving power; list auxiliary demand separately.
steps.observation: 站內損耗與線路損耗是不同項。
steps.observationEn: Station and line losses are separate terms.
steps.failure: 若輸出大於輸入又無儲能釋放，查單位與符號。
steps.failureEn: Check units and signs if output exceeds input without stored-energy release.
steps.check: 帳本閉合且沒有把站用電重複計算。
steps.checkEn: The ledger balances without double-counted auxiliaries.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 能量平衡可先揭露系統模型不一致。
knowledge.textEn: Energy balance can expose an inconsistent system model.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 效率比較需使用相同功率與邊界。
knowledge.textEn: Efficiency comparisons need matching power levels and boundaries.

quiz.question: 比較效率時為何先定邊界？
quiz.questionEn: Why define boundaries before comparing efficiency?
options: 因為效率與輸入無關。
避免一方漏算換流或站用損耗。
為了把所有損耗設為零。
optionsEn: Because efficiency ignores input.
To avoid omitting conversion or auxiliary losses.
To set every loss to zero.
quiz.explanation: 避免一方漏算換流或站用損耗。 能量平衡可先揭露系統模型不一致。
quiz.explanationEn: To avoid omitting conversion or auxiliary losses. Energy balance can expose an inconsistent system model.

steps.title: 比較 LCC 與 VSC 的電網依存
steps.titleEn: Compare LCC and VSC grid dependence
steps.objective: 依外部電網選擇轉換原理。
steps.objectiveEn: Relate conversion principles to grid conditions.
steps.instruction: 畫 LCC 與 VSC 功能方塊；列出換相方式；比較強網、弱網及離岸情境；標記需專案驗證的控制能力。
steps.instructionEn: Draw LCC and VSC blocks; identify commutation methods; compare strong-grid, weak-grid and offshore cases; flag project-specific control capabilities.
steps.observation: 兩類技術不是只差設備尺寸。
steps.observationEn: The technologies differ by more than equipment size.
steps.failure: 不把某產品功能外推為所有 VSC 都具備。
steps.failureEn: Do not generalize one product's features to every VSC.
steps.check: 比較表包含換相、無功與電網依存。
steps.checkEn: Compare commutation, reactive power and grid dependence.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: LCC 與 VSC 使用不同換流原理。
knowledge.textEn: LCC and VSC use different commutation principles.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 適用性取決於電網、容量與控制設計。
knowledge.textEn: Suitability depends on the grid, rating and control design.

quiz.question: 弱網情境可只比較額定 MW 嗎？
quiz.questionEn: Can a weak-grid study compare only rated MW?
options: 可以，所有電網都相同。
可以，頻率與電壓無關。
不能，還需換相與控制條件。
optionsEn: Yes; all grids are identical.
Yes; frequency and voltage are irrelevant.
No; commutation and control conditions matter.
quiz.explanation: 不能，還需換相與控制條件。 LCC 與 VSC 使用不同換流原理。
quiz.explanationEn: No; commutation and control conditions matter. LCC and VSC use different commutation principles.

steps.title: 畫出單極與雙極回路
steps.titleEn: Draw monopole and bipole circuits
steps.objective: 辨認導體、回流及故障後能力。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify conductors, return paths and contingency capability.
steps.instruction: 畫對稱單極及雙極概念圖；標正負極與中性/回流安排；模擬一個極不可用；列出能否繼續輸送需確認的設計條件。
steps.instructionEn: Draw symmetric-monopole and bipole concepts; mark polarities and neutral/return arrangements; model one unavailable pole; list conditions governing continued transfer.
steps.observation: 兩根直流導體不一定代表同一系統配置。
steps.observationEn: Two DC conductors do not always mean the same configuration.
steps.failure: 未確認回流設計前，不宣稱任一極故障仍滿功率。
steps.failureEn: Do not claim full power after a pole failure without verifying the return design.
steps.check: 每種圖有完整回路及備援限制。
steps.checkEn: Each diagram has a complete loop and contingency limits.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 拓撲決定故障隔離與剩餘能力。
knowledge.textEn: Topology shapes fault isolation and remaining capability.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 地回路、金屬回路與導體絕緣需依專案區分。
knowledge.textEn: Earth return, metallic return and insulation are project-specific.

quiz.question: 雙極系統一極失效後能力是否固定？
quiz.questionEn: Is post-pole-failure capability universal?
options: 否，取決於回流與設備額定。
是，永遠維持全部功率。
是，永遠不能傳任何功率。
optionsEn: No; it depends on return arrangements and ratings.
Yes; full power is always retained.
Yes; no power can ever flow.
quiz.explanation: 否，取決於回流與設備額定。 拓撲決定故障隔離與剩餘能力。
quiz.explanationEn: No; it depends on return arrangements and ratings. Topology shapes fault isolation and remaining capability.

steps.title: 比較交流與直流連線的成本邊界
steps.titleEn: Compare AC and DC cost boundaries
steps.objective: 避免以單一損耗率決定方案。
steps.objectiveEn: Avoid choosing a scheme from one loss percentage.
steps.instruction: 列出站、線路、維護與損耗四項成本；用假設距離畫兩種總成本曲線；改變海纜與架空條件；說明交點為何移動。
steps.instructionEn: List station, line, maintenance and loss costs; draw hypothetical total-cost curves against distance; vary cable and overhead cases; explain moving break-even points.
steps.observation: 換流站固定成本與長距離收益需一起看。
steps.observationEn: Converter fixed cost and distance-dependent benefits belong together.
steps.failure: 不把某案例損益兩平距離當通用常數。
steps.failureEn: Do not treat one example's break-even distance as universal.
steps.check: 圖表清楚寫出成本假設及敏感因子。
steps.checkEn: State cost assumptions and sensitivity factors.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 經濟比較包含建設與生命週期成本。
knowledge.textEn: Economic comparison includes construction and lifecycle costs.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 走廊、地形與許可條件會改變方案。
knowledge.textEn: Corridors, terrain and permitting conditions change choices.

quiz.question: 為何不能只用公里數判斷 HVDC？
quiz.questionEn: Why is distance alone insufficient for choosing HVDC?
options: 因為損耗永遠是零。
線路型態與換流站成本也會改變結果。
因為所有站的成本相同。
optionsEn: Because losses are always zero.
Line type and converter cost also change results.
Because every station costs the same.
quiz.explanation: 線路型態與換流站成本也會改變結果。 經濟比較包含建設與生命週期成本。
quiz.explanationEn: Line type and converter cost also change results. Economic comparison includes construction and lifecycle costs.

steps.title: 建立一次設備的介面清單
steps.titleEn: Create the primary-equipment interface register
steps.objective: 將站內設備按功能與訊號相連。
steps.objectiveEn: Connect equipment by function and signal.
steps.instruction: 排列交流場、變壓器、閥廳、直流場；畫電力、冷卻與控制三色連線；為每個介面列責任人角色；找出一個共用失效點。
steps.instructionEn: Arrange AC yard, transformer, valve hall and DC yard; draw power, cooling and control links; assign responsible roles to interfaces; find a shared failure point.
steps.observation: 電氣完整不代表輔助系統已完整。
steps.observationEn: Electrical completeness does not establish auxiliary completeness.
steps.failure: 漏畫站用電或冷卻時，先補介面再談可用率。
steps.failureEn: Add auxiliary power and cooling before assessing availability.
steps.check: 清單覆蓋電力、資訊與熱三種交接。
steps.checkEn: Cover power, information and heat interfaces.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 換流站是多子系統共同運作的工程。
knowledge.textEn: A converter station operates through interacting subsystems.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 共用設備可形成多條路徑的共同失效。
knowledge.textEn: Shared equipment can create common-cause failures.

quiz.question: 只完成主電路能證明可運轉嗎？
quiz.questionEn: Does a complete main circuit establish operability?
options: 能，冷卻不影響轉換。
能，測量只供美觀。
不能，輔助與控制介面也必要。
optionsEn: Yes; cooling cannot affect conversion.
Yes; measurements are decorative.
No; auxiliary and control interfaces are also needed.
quiz.explanation: 不能，輔助與控制介面也必要。 換流站是多子系統共同運作的工程。
quiz.explanationEn: No; auxiliary and control interfaces are also needed. A converter station operates through interacting subsystems.

stages.title: 一次設備與能量路徑
stages.description: 以變壓器、閥、電抗器及冷卻介面拆解設備。
stages.descriptionEn: Decompose transformer, valve, reactor and cooling interfaces.

steps.title: 審查換流變壓器的功能
steps.titleEn: Review converter-transformer duties
steps.objective: 區分變壓、隔離與換流負載。
steps.objectiveEn: Separate transformation, isolation and converter loading.
steps.instruction: 畫交流網與閥側兩端；標變比及絕緣邊界；比較正弦與含諧波電流的假設波形；列出需由設備規範提供的損耗與溫升證據。
steps.instructionEn: Draw grid and valve sides; mark ratio and insulation boundaries; compare sinusoidal and harmonic-rich currents; list loss and temperature evidence required from specifications.
steps.observation: 額定容量相同不表示負載與絕緣應力相同。
steps.observationEn: Equal ratings do not imply equal loading or insulation stress.
steps.failure: 不直接以普通配電變壓器替代未知換流用途。
steps.failureEn: Do not substitute an ordinary distribution transformer for an unspecified converter duty.
steps.check: 功能表含電壓、波形、熱及介面條件。
steps.checkEn: List voltage, waveform, thermal and interface conditions.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 換流變壓器需符合所連接系統的特殊負載。
knowledge.textEn: A converter transformer must match its connected system's duties.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 波形與絕緣應力由配置決定，不能只看名稱。
knowledge.textEn: Configuration determines waveform and insulation stress, not the label alone.

quiz.question: 相同 MVA 就一定可互換嗎？
quiz.questionEn: Does equal MVA guarantee interchangeability?
options: 否，負載與絕緣需求仍不同。
是，其他規格都不重要。
是，只要外形相似。
optionsEn: No; loading and insulation duties may differ.
Yes; other specifications do not matter.
Yes, if the shape is similar.
quiz.explanation: 否，負載與絕緣需求仍不同。 換流變壓器需符合所連接系統的特殊負載。
quiz.explanationEn: No; loading and insulation duties may differ. A converter transformer must match its connected system's duties.

steps.title: 以子模組推演 MMC 電壓階梯
steps.titleEn: Model an MMC voltage staircase
steps.objective: 理解串接模組如何合成電壓。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand voltage synthesis from series modules.
steps.instruction: 用四個抽象電壓模組畫串接；枚舉插入不同數目的電壓；與目標正弦輪廓比較；標註這只是教學模型而非閘極觸發表。
steps.instructionEn: Draw four abstract series voltage modules; enumerate voltages from different inserted counts; compare with a target sinusoid; label the model as educational, not a gate schedule.
steps.observation: 更多電平可使階梯波更接近目標。
steps.observationEn: More levels can bring a staircase closer to the target.
steps.failure: 不把四模組例子當真實 HVDC 額定架構。
steps.failureEn: Do not treat the four-module example as a rated HVDC design.
steps.check: 圖中分開模組狀態、合成電壓及目標。
steps.checkEn: Separate module states, synthesized voltage and target.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: MMC 以多個子模組共同形成換流臂電壓。
knowledge.textEn: MMC uses multiple submodules to form arm voltage.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 教學電壓相加不涵蓋真實開關與保護限制。
knowledge.textEn: Adding teaching voltages omits real switching and protection limits.

quiz.question: 增加抽象電平主要改善什麼？
quiz.questionEn: What do additional abstract voltage levels improve?
options: 自動取消所有損耗。
對目標波形的近似程度。
使絕緣需求消失。
optionsEn: Automatic elimination of all losses.
Approximation to the target waveform.
Elimination of insulation needs.
quiz.explanation: 對目標波形的近似程度。 MMC 以多個子模組共同形成換流臂電壓。
quiz.explanationEn: Approximation to the target waveform. MMC uses multiple submodules to form arm voltage.

steps.title: 檢查模組能量不平衡
steps.titleEn: Inspect module-energy imbalance
steps.objective: 把平均電壓與個別模組狀態分開。
steps.objectiveEn: Separate average voltage from individual module state.
steps.instruction: 為四個假設電容模組畫能量條；保持總能量不變但分配不同；比較最大偏差；提出需要追蹤的個別量測。
steps.instructionEn: Draw energy bars for four hypothetical capacitor modules; redistribute equal total energy; compare the largest deviation; propose per-module measurements.
steps.observation: 總量正常仍可能有單一模組過高。
steps.observationEn: Normal totals can conceal one excessive module state.
steps.failure: 只監看平均值時，增加個別最大最小與時間趨勢。
steps.failureEn: Add individual extrema and trends to average-only monitoring.
steps.check: 報告保留總量與各模組分布。
steps.checkEn: Retain total energy and module distribution.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 模組化系統需同時維持總體及局部狀態。
knowledge.textEn: Modular systems need both global and local state control.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 能量不平衡不能靠總電壓正常直接排除。
knowledge.textEn: A normal total voltage cannot exclude energy imbalance.

quiz.question: 總能量相同能否保證模組均衡？
quiz.questionEn: Does equal total energy prove balanced modules?
options: 可以，總量會自動平均。
可以，只需計算模組數。
不能，必須看分布。
optionsEn: Yes; totals automatically equalize.
Yes; count modules only.
No; inspect the distribution.
quiz.explanation: 不能，必須看分布。 模組化系統需同時維持總體及局部狀態。
quiz.explanationEn: No; inspect the distribution. Modular systems need both global and local state control.

steps.title: 辨認諧波與濾波需求
steps.titleEn: Identify harmonics and filtering needs
steps.objective: 依波形與電網條件評估品質。
steps.objectiveEn: Assess power quality from waveform and grid conditions.
steps.instruction: 疊加基波與一個假設諧波；比較時域形狀；分別記錄頻率與幅度；畫濾波前後的教學頻譜並保留未知阻抗。
steps.instructionEn: Combine a fundamental and a hypothetical harmonic; compare waveform shape; record frequencies and magnitudes; sketch before/after filtering spectra with grid impedance left explicit.
steps.observation: 波形看似平滑不代表所有諧波都符合要求。
steps.observationEn: A smooth-looking waveform does not establish all harmonic requirements.
steps.failure: 不因為採 VSC 就一律刪除諧波研究。
steps.failureEn: Do not omit harmonic studies solely because VSC is used.
steps.check: 結果包含頻譜、量測點與電網假設。
steps.checkEn: Include spectrum, measurement location and grid assumptions.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 換流波形與系統阻抗共同決定諧波影響。
knowledge.textEn: Converter waveforms and system impedance jointly determine harmonic impact.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 濾波需求依拓撲及專案條件而異。
knowledge.textEn: Filtering needs vary by topology and project.

quiz.question: 採用 VSC 就不需要任何諧波評估嗎？
quiz.questionEn: Does VSC eliminate all harmonic assessment?
options: 不是，仍須驗證系統條件。
是，波形永遠完全正弦。
是，電網沒有阻抗。
optionsEn: No; system conditions still need verification.
Yes; waveforms are always perfectly sinusoidal.
Yes; grids have no impedance.
quiz.explanation: 不是，仍須驗證系統條件。 換流波形與系統阻抗共同決定諧波影響。
quiz.explanationEn: No; system conditions still need verification. Converter waveforms and system impedance jointly determine harmonic impact.

steps.title: 建立熱損耗與冷卻回路
steps.titleEn: Build the thermal-loss and cooling loop
steps.objective: 把閥損耗轉成需移除的熱。
steps.objectiveEn: Translate valve losses into heat-removal demand.
steps.instruction: 畫功率元件到冷卻液及熱交換器的熱路徑；用假設熱量做平衡；標泵與感測器；比較一台泵停用的備援情境。
steps.instructionEn: Draw heat paths from devices through coolant to exchanger; balance hypothetical heat; mark pumps and sensors; compare a one-pump-unavailable case.
steps.observation: 冷卻備援需包含電源與控制依存。
steps.observationEn: Cooling redundancy includes power and control dependencies.
steps.failure: 若兩泵共用單一供電，不把它們算成完全獨立備援。
steps.failureEn: Do not call two pumps independent if they share one supply.
steps.check: 熱路徑與共同失效點均可追溯。
steps.checkEn: Trace heat paths and common-cause points.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 電力電子損耗必須透過可用熱路徑移除。
knowledge.textEn: Power-electronic losses need an available heat-removal path.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 冗餘台數不等於端到端冗餘。
knowledge.textEn: Redundant unit counts do not equal end-to-end redundancy.

quiz.question: 兩台泵是否必然有完整冷卻備援？
quiz.questionEn: Do two pumps guarantee complete cooling redundancy?
options: 是，台數就是可用率。
否，還要看共用電源、管路與控制。
是，不需熱交換器。
optionsEn: Yes; count alone is availability.
No; check shared supply, piping and control.
Yes; no exchanger is needed.
quiz.explanation: 否，還要看共用電源、管路與控制。 電力電子損耗必須透過可用熱路徑移除。
quiz.explanationEn: No; check shared supply, piping and control. Power-electronic losses need an available heat-removal path.

steps.title: 區分電氣絕緣與冷卻水品質
steps.titleEn: Separate insulation from coolant quality
steps.objective: 辨認熱與電之間的耦合。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify coupling between thermal and electrical design.
steps.instruction: 畫帶電元件及冷卻回路邊界；標出熱傳路徑與不希望的電流路徑；比較假設導電度變化；列出所需品質監測而不填設備門檻。
steps.instructionEn: Draw energized-device and cooling boundaries; mark desired heat and undesired current paths; compare hypothetical conductivity changes; list monitoring needs without equipment thresholds.
steps.observation: 冷卻液能帶走熱，也可能形成非預期導電路徑。
steps.observationEn: Coolant transports heat but can create unwanted conduction.
steps.failure: 不把一般水質「清澈」當作低導電度證據。
steps.failureEn: Visual clarity does not prove low conductivity.
steps.check: 說明熱、導電度與絕緣三項介面。
steps.checkEn: Explain thermal, conductivity and insulation interfaces.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: HVDC 閥冷卻需考慮低導電度與純度。
knowledge.textEn: HVDC valve cooling considers low conductivity and purity.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 外觀檢查不能取代量測水質。
knowledge.textEn: Appearance cannot replace measured coolant quality.

quiz.question: 水看起來清澈足以判斷可用嗎？
quiz.questionEn: Is visibly clear water enough to establish suitability?
options: 足夠，清水一定不導電。
足夠，冷卻與絕緣無關。
不足，需相應品質與導電度證據。
optionsEn: Yes; clear water never conducts.
Yes; cooling is unrelated to insulation.
No; quality and conductivity evidence are needed.
quiz.explanation: 不足，需相應品質與導電度證據。 HVDC 閥冷卻需考慮低導電度與純度。
quiz.explanationEn: No; quality and conductivity evidence are needed. HVDC valve cooling considers low conductivity and purity.

stages.title: 控制、保護與故障情境
stages.description: 只用模型審查控制責任及失效回應，不操作實際高壓設備。
stages.descriptionEn: Review control roles and fault responses in models only, without operating high-voltage equipment.

steps.title: 分配有功與無功控制責任
steps.titleEn: Assign active and reactive control roles
steps.objective: 避免把兩個控制目標混為一談。
steps.objectiveEn: Avoid conflating two control objectives.
steps.instruction: 畫有功、無功兩個示意軸；為受端列功率輸送與電壓支持需求；加入假設容量邊界；比較同時要求兩者增加時的取捨。
steps.instructionEn: Draw active and reactive axes; specify transfer and voltage-support needs; add a hypothetical capability boundary; compare demands that increase both.
steps.observation: 設備容量有限，控制目標可能互相限制。
steps.observationEn: Finite equipment capacity can constrain competing objectives.
steps.failure: 不將示意能力圓當任何站的真實能力曲線。
steps.failureEn: Do not treat a schematic circle as a real station capability curve.
steps.check: 每個控制目標有量測、限制及協調對象。
steps.checkEn: Each objective has measurements, limits and coordination roles.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 有功與無功描述不同的交流功率關係。
knowledge.textEn: Active and reactive power describe different AC power relationships.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 可用控制能力需由拓撲與額定共同限定。
knowledge.textEn: Topology and ratings constrain available control capability.

quiz.question: 能否不受限制地同時增加有功與無功？
quiz.questionEn: Can active and reactive power rise without limit together?
options: 不能，需遵守設備能力與電網條件。
可以，控制軟體沒有額定。
可以，只需改畫面數字。
optionsEn: No; equipment capability and grid conditions constrain them.
Yes; software has no rating.
Yes; change the displayed number.
quiz.explanation: 不能，需遵守設備能力與電網條件。 有功與無功描述不同的交流功率關係。
quiz.explanationEn: No; equipment capability and grid conditions constrain them. Active and reactive power describe different AC power relationships.

steps.title: 建立量測到保護的資料鏈
steps.titleEn: Build the measurement-to-protection chain
steps.objective: 追蹤感測、時間與判斷品質。
steps.objectiveEn: Trace sensing, timing and decision quality.
steps.instruction: 畫電流感測、資料傳輸、判斷及記錄鏈；加入假設延遲；標出時間戳來源；比較遺失資料與真實零值的差異。
steps.instructionEn: Draw sensing, transmission, decision and recording links; add hypothetical delay; mark timestamp sources; distinguish missing data from a real zero.
steps.observation: 數值有效性與數值大小同樣重要。
steps.observationEn: Data validity matters as much as magnitude.
steps.failure: 缺測時不填零；明確標示品質及失效狀態。
steps.failureEn: Do not replace missing samples with zero; preserve quality and failure states.
steps.check: 鏈中每個節點有時間、品質與責任。
steps.checkEn: Each link records time, quality and responsibility.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 控制與保護依賴可信且及時的量測。
knowledge.textEn: Control and protection depend on trustworthy, timely measurements.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 事件回放需能對齊多設備時間線。
knowledge.textEn: Event replay needs aligned timelines across devices.

quiz.question: 缺測可以直接視為零電流嗎？
quiz.questionEn: Can a missing sample be treated as zero current?
options: 可以，缺值本來就是零。
不可以，兩者意義不同。
可以，只要儀表畫面正常。
optionsEn: Yes; missing always means zero.
No; they mean different things.
Yes, if the display looks normal.
quiz.explanation: 不可以，兩者意義不同。 控制與保護依賴可信且及時的量測。
quiz.explanationEn: No; they mean different things. Control and protection depend on trustworthy, timely measurements.

steps.title: 比較交流與直流故障波形
steps.titleEn: Compare AC and DC fault waveforms
steps.objective: 理解自然過零與故障隔離的差別。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand natural current zero and isolation differences.
steps.instruction: 畫交流與直流正常電流；加入假設故障上升；標記交流過零；說明直流隔離為何需專用設計，不編寫現場操作順序。
steps.instructionEn: Draw normal AC and DC currents; add hypothetical fault rise; mark AC zero crossings; explain DC isolation needs without writing field switching instructions.
steps.observation: 直流沒有每週期自然過零的同樣條件。
steps.observationEn: DC lacks the same periodic natural-zero condition.
steps.failure: 不可把交流斷路器能力直接套用為直流能力。
steps.failureEn: Do not directly transfer AC breaker capability to DC.
steps.check: 對照圖列出故障型態及隔離驗證需求。
steps.checkEn: Compare fault forms and required isolation verification.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: AC 與 DC 故障隔離具有不同物理條件。
knowledge.textEn: AC and DC fault isolation have different physical conditions.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 保護設計必須與拓撲、設備及能量路徑一致。
knowledge.textEn: Protection must match topology, equipment and energy paths.

quiz.question: 為何不能直接照搬交流隔離設計？
quiz.questionEn: Why not directly copy AC isolation design?
options: 因為直流永遠沒有故障。
因為兩者波形完全相同。
直流缺少相同的自然電流過零條件。
optionsEn: Because DC cannot fault.
Because their waveforms are identical.
DC lacks the same natural current-zero condition.
quiz.explanation: 直流缺少相同的自然電流過零條件。 AC 與 DC 故障隔離具有不同物理條件。
quiz.explanationEn: DC lacks the same natural current-zero condition. AC and DC fault isolation have different physical conditions.

steps.title: 審查控制與保護的分工
steps.titleEn: Review control versus protection roles
steps.objective: 區分維持目標與限制失效後果。
steps.objectiveEn: Separate regulation from limiting failure consequences.
steps.instruction: 列出正常功率變化、量測異常與設備故障三案例；將例子分到控制或保護責任；畫互相通報介面；列出需聯合測試的邊界情境。
steps.instructionEn: List routine power change, bad measurement and equipment fault cases; assign control or protection roles; draw notification interfaces; list boundary cases for joint tests.
steps.observation: 同一事件可能需要不同層級協調。
steps.observationEn: One event can need coordination across layers.
steps.failure: 不要把所有異常都當同一停止命令；先清楚定義責任。
steps.failureEn: Do not treat every anomaly as one identical stop command; define roles first.
steps.check: 分工表包含目標、輸入、限制與驗證案例。
steps.checkEn: Include objectives, inputs, limits and verification cases.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 控制追蹤工作目標；保護限制故障影響。
knowledge.textEn: Control follows operating objectives; protection limits fault effects.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 兩者應協調但保留可驗證的責任邊界。
knowledge.textEn: They coordinate while retaining verifiable responsibility boundaries.

quiz.question: 正常功率調整和設備故障應相同處理嗎？
quiz.questionEn: Should routine power adjustment and equipment failure be handled identically?
options: 不應，責任與情境不同。
應，所有變化都是故障。
應，保護不需量測。
optionsEn: No; roles and contexts differ.
Yes; every change is a fault.
Yes; protection needs no measurements.
quiz.explanation: 不應，責任與情境不同。 控制追蹤工作目標；保護限制故障影響。
quiz.explanationEn: No; roles and contexts differ. Control follows operating objectives; protection limits fault effects.

steps.title: 辨認通訊失效與備援邊界
steps.titleEn: Identify communication and redundancy boundaries
steps.objective: 找出重複設備中的共同依存。
steps.objectiveEn: Find shared dependencies in duplicated equipment.
steps.instruction: 畫兩控制器、兩網路及站用電；標共用時鐘與交換設備；移除一個共用元件做紙上推演；記錄仍可用的觀測與功能。
steps.instructionEn: Draw two controllers, networks and auxiliaries; mark shared clocks and switches; remove one common element on paper; record remaining observability and functions.
steps.observation: 數量翻倍仍可能共用單一失效點。
steps.observationEn: Duplicated counts can still share a single failure point.
steps.failure: 不以「雙機」直接宣告全站無中斷。
steps.failureEn: Do not infer uninterrupted station operation from two controllers alone.
steps.check: 備援圖標出獨立與共用部分。
steps.checkEn: Mark independent and shared portions of the redundancy diagram.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 備援有效性取決於完整依存路徑。
knowledge.textEn: Redundancy depends on complete dependency paths.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 故障記錄本身也需可用性與時間一致性。
knowledge.textEn: Fault recording also needs availability and time consistency.

quiz.question: 雙控制器但共用單一電源的弱點是？
quiz.questionEn: What weak point remains with two controllers on one supply?
options: 控制器數量太偶數。
電源可能造成共同失效。
圖表顏色不足。
optionsEn: The count is an even number.
The supply can cause a common failure.
The diagram lacks colors.
quiz.explanation: 電源可能造成共同失效。 備援有效性取決於完整依存路徑。
quiz.explanationEn: The supply can cause a common failure. Redundancy depends on complete dependency paths.

steps.title: 以直流能量平衡檢查控制互動
steps.titleEn: Check control interaction through DC energy balance
steps.objective: 將送受端功率差連到儲能變化。
steps.objectiveEn: Relate terminal power mismatch to stored-energy change.
steps.instruction: 畫送端、直流電容等效儲能及受端；建立短時間功率不匹配的假設；計算多出或不足的能量；討論哪一端需協調而不填控制器設定。
steps.instructionEn: Draw sending power, equivalent DC capacitive storage and receiving power; introduce a brief hypothetical mismatch; calculate excess or missing energy; discuss terminal coordination without controller settings.
steps.observation: 兩端功率不平衡會改變系統儲能狀態。
steps.observationEn: Unbalanced terminal power changes stored energy.
steps.failure: 若假設直流電壓永遠不變，補上維持平衡所需的控制或外部能量路徑。
steps.failureEn: If DC voltage is assumed fixed, identify the control or energy path maintaining balance.
steps.check: 能量帳本說明暫態輸入、輸出與儲存項。
steps.checkEn: The transient ledger includes input, output and stored energy.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 穩態功率平衡不能取代暫態能量分析。
knowledge.textEn: Steady power balance does not replace transient energy analysis.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 兩站控制目標需協調以維持可接受狀態。
knowledge.textEn: Terminal control objectives need coordination to maintain acceptable states.

quiz.question: 送端輸入突然大於受端輸出會如何？
quiz.questionEn: What follows when sending input briefly exceeds receiving output?
options: 多出能量會無條件消失。
直流系統不遵守能量守恆。
多出的能量需儲存或經其他路徑處理。
optionsEn: Excess energy disappears unconditionally.
DC systems do not conserve energy.
Excess energy must be stored or handled by another path.
quiz.explanation: 多出的能量需儲存或經其他路徑處理。 穩態功率平衡不能取代暫態能量分析。
quiz.explanationEn: Excess energy must be stored or handled by another path. Steady power balance does not replace transient energy analysis.

stages.title: 整合、測試與生命週期
stages.description: 把模擬、工廠驗收、環境與維護需求整合。
stages.descriptionEn: Integrate simulation, factory acceptance, environment and maintenance needs.

steps.title: 規劃工廠整合測試矩陣
steps.titleEn: Plan a factory integration-test matrix
steps.objective: 將需求轉成可檢查案例。
steps.objectiveEn: Turn requirements into verifiable cases.
steps.instruction: 把功率控制、冷卻與備援需求列成列；把正常、邊界與失效列成欄；填入模擬输入及預期證據；指出哪些需現地條件才可驗證。
steps.instructionEn: Use control, cooling and redundancy requirements as rows and normal, boundary and failure cases as columns; fill simulated inputs and evidence; flag site-dependent tests.
steps.observation: 工廠通過不表示所有現地介面已驗證。
steps.observationEn: Factory success does not verify every site interface.
steps.failure: 沒有判定條件的測試改成可量測輸出與紀錄。
steps.failureEn: Replace vague tests with measurable outputs and records.
steps.check: 每項需求至少對應一個正常及一個邊界案例。
steps.checkEn: Map each requirement to a normal and a boundary case.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 整合測試重點是設備間行為而非單件合格證。
knowledge.textEn: Integration tests focus on inter-equipment behavior, beyond unit certificates.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 工廠與現地驗收有不同可覆蓋範圍。
knowledge.textEn: Factory and site acceptance have different coverage.

quiz.question: 工廠測試後為何仍需現地驗證？
quiz.questionEn: Why verify the site after factory tests?
options: 現地電網、安裝與介面條件不同。
因為工廠測試毫無價值。
只為再拍一次照片。
optionsEn: Grid, installation and interfaces differ on site.
Because factory tests have no value.
Only to take another photo.
quiz.explanation: 現地電網、安裝與介面條件不同。 整合測試重點是設備間行為而非單件合格證。
quiz.explanationEn: Grid, installation and interfaces differ on site. Integration tests focus on inter-equipment behavior, beyond unit certificates.

steps.title: 建立故障回放與模型校核
steps.titleEn: Build event replay and model checks
steps.objective: 把實測時間序列連回模擬假設。
steps.objectiveEn: Relate event timelines to model assumptions.
steps.instruction: 建立假設事件前後資料表；對齊電壓、電流、控制狀態與告警；比較模型預測；只更改有證據支持的模型參數。
steps.instructionEn: Create a hypothetical event table; align voltage, current, control state and alarms; compare predictions; change only evidence-supported model parameters.
steps.observation: 告警先後可能受延遲與記錄方式影響。
steps.observationEn: Alarm order can reflect delay and recording methods.
steps.failure: 不能把最早顯示的告警直接當根因。
steps.failureEn: Do not equate the first displayed alarm with root cause.
steps.check: 時間線標記時間誤差、假說及未解殘差。
steps.checkEn: Mark timing uncertainty, hypotheses and unresolved residuals.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 模型校核需要多種觀測的一致性。
knowledge.textEn: Model checks require consistency across several observations.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 調參擬合單一事件可能犧牲其他條件的有效性。
knowledge.textEn: Fitting one event can reduce validity elsewhere.

quiz.question: 第一個告警一定是根因嗎？
quiz.questionEn: Is the first alarm necessarily the root cause?
options: 一定，告警沒有延遲。
不一定，需校正時間與資料延遲。
一定，其他紀錄都可刪除。
optionsEn: Yes; alarms have no delay.
No; account for timing and data delay.
Yes; all other records may be discarded.
quiz.explanation: 不一定，需校正時間與資料延遲。 模型校核需要多種觀測的一致性。
quiz.explanationEn: No; account for timing and data delay. Model checks require consistency across several observations.

steps.title: 檢查噪音、占地與冷卻排熱
steps.titleEn: Review noise, footprint and heat rejection
steps.objective: 將站外影響納入設計。
steps.objectiveEn: Include off-site impacts in the design.
steps.instruction: 畫站區與鄰近敏感受體；標變壓器、風機及熱交換器；比較兩種配置的聲源距離與維修路徑；列需專業環境評估的未知項。
steps.instructionEn: Draw station and neighboring receptors; mark transformers, fans and exchangers; compare source distance and maintenance access for two layouts; list environmental-study gaps.
steps.observation: 縮小站區可能增加維護或排熱衝突。
steps.observationEn: A smaller footprint can conflict with access or heat rejection.
steps.failure: 不以示意圖宣稱符合當地環境規定。
steps.failureEn: Do not claim local compliance from a schematic.
steps.check: 配置比較同時包含設備、維修及外部受體。
steps.checkEn: Compare equipment, maintenance and surrounding receptors.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 工程配置需整合電氣與環境需求。
knowledge.textEn: Layout integrates electrical and environmental needs.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 總噪音不能只用某一設備型錄值代表。
knowledge.textEn: A single equipment catalog value does not represent total site noise.

quiz.question: 站區越小是否一定越好？
quiz.questionEn: Is a smaller station always better?
options: 一定，任何通道都可刪掉。
一定，排熱不需空間。
不一定，須兼顧維修與環境影響。
optionsEn: Yes; all access routes may be removed.
Yes; heat rejection needs no space.
No; maintenance and environmental effects matter.
quiz.explanation: 不一定，須兼顧維修與環境影響。 工程配置需整合電氣與環境需求。
quiz.explanationEn: No; maintenance and environmental effects matter. Layout integrates electrical and environmental needs.

steps.title: 建立備品與維護依存圖
steps.titleEn: Map spares and maintenance dependencies
steps.objective: 把可用率連到可修復性。
steps.objectiveEn: Relate availability to repairability.
steps.instruction: 選三類設備建立失效與更換假說；列備品、技能及停機範圍；比較共用與專用備品；記錄供應與相容性需確認項。
steps.instructionEn: Choose three equipment classes and replacement scenarios; list spares, skills and outage extent; compare shared and dedicated spares; flag supply and compatibility uncertainties.
steps.observation: 備品存在不代表可立即更換或相容。
steps.observationEn: An available spare may not be immediately usable or compatible.
steps.failure: 不要用平均維修時間掩蓋特殊大型設備物流。
steps.failureEn: Do not hide exceptional heavy-equipment logistics in a mean repair time.
steps.check: 圖表包括備品、工具、介面及恢復驗證。
steps.checkEn: Include spares, tools, interfaces and restoration checks.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 長壽命工程需要持續維護與改版管理。
knowledge.textEn: Long-lived infrastructure needs maintenance and change management.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 控制升級需保留與既有設備的相容證據。
knowledge.textEn: Control upgrades need evidence of compatibility with existing equipment.

quiz.question: 有備品就一定可快速恢復嗎？
quiz.questionEn: Does having a spare guarantee fast recovery?
options: 不一定，還需相容性、技能與物流。
一定，所有設備可熱插拔。
一定，恢復後不用測試。
optionsEn: No; compatibility, skills and logistics matter.
Yes; all equipment is hot-swappable.
Yes; no restoration testing is needed.
quiz.explanation: 不一定，還需相容性、技能與物流。 長壽命工程需要持續維護與改版管理。
quiz.explanationEn: No; compatibility, skills and logistics matter. Long-lived infrastructure needs maintenance and change management.

steps.title: 比較哥特蘭、海上風電與電網互聯
steps.titleEn: Compare Gotland, offshore wind and interconnectors
steps.objective: 辨認共享工法與不同系統目標。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify shared methods and different system goals.
steps.instruction: 把 1954 哥特蘭鏈路與 1999 島內 VSC 案例分開；加入假設海上風電連線；比較換流、海纜/陸纜及電網強度；挑一項共同技能延伸。
steps.instructionEn: Separate the 1954 Gotland link from the 1999 island VSC case; add a hypothetical offshore-wind link; compare conversion, cable environment and grid strength; select a shared skill.
steps.observation: 同一島嶼上的兩項工程不等於同一連線。
steps.observationEn: Two projects on one island are not the same link.
steps.failure: 歷史技術不可直接標為現在設備配置。
steps.failureEn: Do not label historical technology as the current installed configuration.
steps.check: 比較表有各案例年代、範圍與共同介面。
steps.checkEn: State dates, scope and shared interfaces for each case.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: HVDC 歷史包含不同閥技術與應用目的。
knowledge.textEn: HVDC history includes changing valve technologies and uses.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 可轉移的是系統分析方法，額定與控制需重審。
knowledge.textEn: System-analysis methods transfer; ratings and control need renewed review.

quiz.question: 1954 與 1999 哥特蘭案例應如何呈現？
quiz.questionEn: How should the 1954 and 1999 Gotland cases be presented?
options: 合併成完全相同的站。
分開工程、技術與年代。
把兩者都當 MMC 原型。
optionsEn: Merge them into one identical station.
Distinguish projects, technologies and dates.
Treat both as MMC prototypes.
quiz.explanation: 分開工程、技術與年代。 HVDC 歷史包含不同閥技術與應用目的。
quiz.explanationEn: Distinguish projects, technologies and dates. HVDC history includes changing valve technologies and uses.

steps.title: 完成換流站概念審查
steps.titleEn: Complete the converter-station concept review
steps.objective: 形成可供專業團隊接續的需求證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce requirements evidence for subsequent professional work.
steps.instruction: 整理單線概念圖、能量帳本與測試矩陣；列出未取得的電網資料；為最高風險介面提出下一步研究；標明本課程不授權現場送電。
steps.instructionEn: Collect concept single-line diagram, energy ledger and test matrix; list missing grid data; propose study of the highest-risk interface; state that the course does not authorize energization.
steps.observation: 概念合理不等於已完成設備設計與資格審查。
steps.observationEn: A sound concept is not completed equipment design or qualification.
steps.failure: 不要把未填額定與保護參數的示意圖當施工圖。
steps.failureEn: Do not treat unrated, unparameterized schematics as construction drawings.
steps.check: 每個需求可連回模型、來源或待確認責任。
steps.checkEn: Trace each requirement to a model, source or assigned verification.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 總工程師需管理子系統介面及證據缺口。
knowledge.textEn: A chief engineer manages interfaces and evidence gaps.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 教育審查的成果是判斷框架與交付資料。
knowledge.textEn: Educational review delivers a reasoning framework and documentation.

quiz.question: 本課程完成後可據此直接操作高壓站嗎？
quiz.questionEn: Does course completion authorize operating a high-voltage station?
options: 可以，示意圖就是操作票。
可以，不需專業驗證。
不可以，成果是概念學習與審查資料。
optionsEn: Yes; the schematic is an operating permit.
Yes; no professional verification is needed.
No; the result is conceptual learning and review material.
quiz.explanation: 不可以，成果是概念學習與審查資料。 總工程師需管理子系統介面及證據缺口。
quiz.explanationEn: No; the result is conceptual learning and review material. A chief engineer manages interfaces and evidence gaps.
